{
  "root_cause": "The PC was configured with an incorrect subnet mask of 255.255.255.240 instead of 255.255.255.0, causing it to treat other devices in its own VLAN (like 10.10.4.80) as being on a remote network and failing to reach them directly.",
  "confidence": 100,
  "evidence": "ipconfig /all shows the subnet mask is 255.255.255.240, and pinging 10.10.4.80 results in a 'Destination host unreachable' error because that IP falls outside the PC's computed local subnet range.",
  "next_command": "ipconfig (to verify the network configuration locally)",
  "fix_steps": [
    "Access the network adapter properties on the PC.",
    "Change the IPv4 Subnet Mask from 255.255.255.240 to 255.255.255.0.",
    "Test connectivity by pinging devices across the entire VLAN subnet."
  ]
}

Change the IPv4 Subnet Mask from 255.255.255.240 to 255.255.255.0.
